title: Dark Heresy II domain audit and bounded rules-correctness hardening
summary: Audited the actual supported DH2 scope, fixed two high-confidence domain mismatches, and verified the touched Swift and web surfaces locally. The app is materially safer and more rules-correct within its bounded scope, but full DH2 generation automation and real-device validation remain out of scope.
accepted_scope: Shared skill training ranks and modifiers
Bounded XP progression ordering for skill ranks
Web new-character defaults and sparse storage recovery behavior
rejected_scope: Full talent and advancement table implementation
residual_risks: Manual profile choices still do not automatically drive DH2 starting packages.
UI confidence is based on automated coverage plus static inspection, not a manual simulator/device smoke pass.
Broader DH2 systems remain intentionally partial or out of scope.
required_followups: If the product goal is full character-generation trust, implement a rule-driven creation pipeline instead of manual profile storage.
Add higher-level UI smoke coverage for blank-character creation/edit/progression on the web surface.
Plan a separate pass for home world/background/role package correctness if those choices are meant to become authoritative.
